Algebra 1 · Unit 8: Quadratic Equations and Functions

Factoring Quadratics

Solve quadratic equations by factoring and the zero-product property.

What you’ll learn

  • Solve quadratics using the zero-product property
  • Rewrite in standard form before factoring
  • Interpret the solutions in context

The mountain biking connection

Factor a height equation to find when a rider is back at takeoff height.
